name: John
note:
Given our last discussion about your new role, I figured I'd show you something I recently launched to empower folks to build tools for themselves. The limit is your imagination. I simply looked up your LinkedIn job title and company's market as an example, and chose one of the suggested trending topics, but you can talk about anything.

This is not a sell by any means. You can build your first app for free and leave it at that, but who knows, maybe you will want to keep hatching.

Enjoy brother.
appLine: Score the leads you're working, chase the warm ones first.
lede: Five minutes and nineteen seconds from the first question to a working app at its own link. The rest of the video is just me clicking around inside it.

highlight.label: The app was live at 5:19
highlight.sub: That's the build done, from a blank screen to a working app at its own link. Everything after it is me poking around inside the thing. Tap to jump straight there.

ogDesc: I said a problem out loud, and five minutes later it was a working app at its own link. Here's the whole thing, and the app is yours.
